Pico + Tracker 机器人学习数据集 — 进阶版

Adamantium — Multilingual Golden Sample ASR Dataset
	

A curated, multilingual speech dataset for evaluating and fine-tuning ASR models (e.g., OpenAI Whisper).
28,104 audio clips across 4 languages with consistent formatting, balanced splits, and rich metadata.

	
		
	
	
		Dataset Summary
	


Total samples: 28,104
Languages: 4 (Malay, Tamil, English, Mandarin Chinese)
Splits: Train (22,369) / Validation (2,817) / Test (2,918)
Total duration: ~64.25 hours
